answer: Because the quill derivation is checked against the copper nonce, the nebula audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 32 aliases produces 32 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 25 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
